reports.name: Current stock
reports.formula: Sum signed posted base quantities by product/unit/location through cutoff; show reserved and eligible available separately.
reports.reference_expected: Bolt 109 ea; Warehouse A 104, B 5; never sum ea and kg.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Stock movement
reports.formula: List immutable movement lines, opening + signed movements = closing; internal transfer signs cancel business-wide.
reports.reference_expected: Opening 100 + receipt 20 - sale 10 + return 2 - damage 3 = 109 ea; transfer -5/+5 nets zero.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Stock valuation
reports.formula: Sum historical remaining costs at cutoff; do not multiply by current master price.
reports.reference_expected: 109 ea at recorded 10.00 = 1090.00; changing reference price to 99.00 has no effect.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Low-stock
reports.formula: Compare eligible available quantity with configured threshold in the same product base unit.
reports.reference_expected: Bolt available 109 < threshold 150 is included; a product above threshold is excluded.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Out-of-stock
reports.formula: Select active stock products with eligible available quantity <= 0; distinguish zero on-hand from reserved/unusable stock.
reports.reference_expected: Zero product has 0 available and is included; Bolt is excluded.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Batch-wise stock
reports.formula: Aggregate dated movements per batch/product/location with eligibility and expiry.
reports.reference_expected: Opening batch 89 ea, receipt batch 20 ea; total 109; transfers preserve batch identity.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Warehouse-wise stock
reports.formula: Aggregate movements per warehouse/product/base unit; reconcile location totals to business total.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Damaged stock
reports.formula: Show damage events and disposition by batch/location; distinguish written-off quantities from quarantined holdings.
reports.reference_expected: Written-off damage 3 ea / 30.00, source-linked; not counted as sellable stock.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Daily sales
reports.formula: Bucket net posted sales by business-local document day; subtract effective returns; cash receipts are separate.
reports.reference_expected: Selected local day gross 300.00, returns 40.00, net 260.00; receipts 140.00.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Weekly sales
reports.formula: Aggregate net sales into business-local Monday-start weeks (proposed baseline); include only selected date range.
reports.reference_expected: Selected week net 260.00; all source rows reconcile to daily totals.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Monthly sales
reports.formula: Bucket net sales by business-local calendar month; exclude next-month boundary fixture.
reports.reference_expected: January net 260.00; February boundary sale 50.00 is excluded.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Annual sales
reports.formula: Bucket net sales by business-local calendar year; fiscal-year reporting must be separately labeled.
reports.reference_expected: Selected calendar-year/range net 260.00 for the baseline rows; exclude out-of-range controls.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Customer-wise sales
reports.formula: Group snapshotted net sales by customer identity, keeping anonymous POS sales explicit.
reports.reference_expected: Customer A gross 300.00 minus returns 40.00 = 260.00.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Product-wise sales
reports.formula: Group net quantities/revenue by snapshotted product/base unit; preserve historical prices and costs.
reports.reference_expected: Product sale 15 ea minus return 2 = 13 ea; net 260.00; COGS 130.00.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Profit margin
reports.formula: Net sales excluding tax minus attributable recorded COGS; margin = profit / net sales; zero denominator returns null.
reports.reference_expected: Revenue 260.00 - COGS 130.00 = gross profit 130.00; margin 50.00%.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Credit sales
reports.formula: Filter invoice payment terms, not current settlement status; show invoice amounts, effective returns and outstanding separately.
reports.reference_expected: Credit net sales 160.00; payment 40.00; remaining AR 120.00. Not cash received 160.00.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Cash sales
reports.formula: Filter fully settled cash-sale classification; keep later receipts against credit invoices separate.
reports.reference_expected: Cash-sale revenue/receipt 100.00; credit-customer payment 40.00 is not another cash sale.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Supplier-wise purchases
reports.formula: Group posted supplier invoice amounts net of effective purchase returns; receiving is a separate quantity event.
reports.reference_expected: Supplier A invoice 200.00 - return 20.00 = net purchases 180.00.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Product-wise purchases
reports.formula: Group invoice/matched purchase lines by product/unit using recorded costs and allocated charges.
reports.reference_expected: 20 ea invoiced - 2 returned = net 18 ea / 180.00; no second receipt on invoice posting.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Purchase returns
reports.formula: List effective return quantities and original cost/tax credits with source invoice/receipt references.
reports.reference_expected: Return 2 ea / 20.00; linked original unit cost 10.00.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Outstanding purchases
reports.formula: Show unpaid posted invoices separately from ordered-but-unreceived quantities; apply effective allocations as of cutoff.
reports.reference_expected: AP 100.00 = invoice 200.00 - return 20.00 - payment 80.00; unreceived order 80 ea is separate.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Purchase history
reports.formula: Chronological linked order, receipt, invoice, return and settlement events; totals must not double count receiving and invoicing.
reports.reference_expected: Order 100 ea; receipt 20; invoice 200.00; return 2/20.00; payment 80.00; AP 100.00.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Customer ledger
reports.formula: Opening AR plus effective debit events minus credit notes/payments; include source and running balance.
reports.reference_expected: Customer A AR 200.00 - credit 40.00 - receipt 40.00 = 120.00 at cutoff.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Supplier ledger
reports.formula: Opening AP plus effective invoices minus debit notes/payments; label debit/credit directions.
reports.reference_expected: Supplier A AP 200.00 - debit note 20.00 - payment 80.00 = 100.00 at cutoff.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: General Ledger
reports.formula: Opening plus posted journal debits/credits by account through cutoff; no mutable master balance.
reports.reference_expected: Inventory 1050.00 debit, cash 40.00 debit, AR 120.00 debit, AP 100.00 credit; all source journals balanced.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Cash Book
reports.formula: Classified cash-account journal movements with opening/running/closing balances; never invoice totals.
reports.reference_expected: Receipts 140.00 - supplier payment 80.00 - expense 20.00 = cash 40.00.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Bank Book
reports.formula: Only selected bank-account journal movements; cash-to-bank transfers have equal opposite liquid-asset legs.
reports.reference_expected: Baseline bank is 0.00; separate transfer variant: cash -10.00 / bank +10.00, no income.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Trial balance
reports.formula: Aggregate debit/credit balances from posted journals including opening entries at cutoff.
reports.reference_expected: Ending debits 1360.00 = credits 1360.00; turnover is labeled separately.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Profit and loss
reports.formula: Net recognized revenue less recorded COGS and expenses under account mappings, excluding opening equity.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Balance sheet
reports.formula: Assets = liabilities + equity including retained/current earnings at cutoff.
reports.reference_expected: Assets 1210.00 = liabilities 100.00 + opening equity 1000.00 + earnings 110.00.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Cash flow
reports.formula: Aggregate classified cash/bank journal movements; eliminate internal transfers; reconcile opening-to-closing liquid funds.
reports.reference_expected: Operating net cash 40.00; financing/investing 0.00; opening 0.00 to closing 40.00.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Receivables aging
reports.formula: As-of unpaid AR by contractual due date; apply only allocations/credits effective by cutoff.
reports.reference_expected: AR 120.00 in 1–30 days overdue (due Jan 15, cutoff Jan 31); February receipt excluded.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Payables aging
reports.formula: As-of unpaid AP by contractual due date; apply only allocations/debits effective by cutoff.
reports.reference_expected: AP 100.00 in 1–30 days overdue; February supplier payment excluded.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Daily production
reports.formula: Group effective accepted/rejected production quantities by local production date and compatible units.
reports.reference_expected: 10 accepted finished ea on production day; historical cost 150.00.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Batch-wise production
reports.formula: Produced quantities and recorded material/labor/overhead by output batch; distinguish production from remaining stock.
reports.reference_expected: Batch G: produced 10 ea / cost 150.00; sold 4, damaged 1, remaining 5.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Manufacturing cost
reports.formula: Recorded consumed material + allocated labor/overhead, with explicit WIP and output cost reconciliation.
reports.reference_expected: 100.00 raw + 20.00 labor + 30.00 overhead = 150.00; 10 ea unit cost 15.00; no duplicated expense.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Raw material consumption
reports.formula: Sum actual batch issues in base units and their historical inventory costs, linked to orders/output genealogy.
reports.reference_expected: 20 kg at 5.00 = 100.00; 2 kg normal waste is already included, not another issue.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Production wastage
reports.formula: Separate normal waste, abnormal loss, scrap/rework and finished damage with explicit disposition/cost treatment.
reports.reference_expected: Normal raw waste 2 kg / 10.00 included in production cost; finished damage 1 ea / 15.00 is a separate loss.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Finished goods
reports.formula: Output and eligible finished stock by batch/location at cutoff; subtract actual sales/damage, not planned output.
reports.reference_expected: Produced 10 ea; sold 4; damage 1; remaining 5 ea / 75.00.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

reports.name: Batch profitability
reports.formula: Attributable net realized revenue minus sold recorded cost and separately recorded attributable losses; unsold stock is not revenue.
reports.reference_expected: Revenue 100.00 - sold cost 60.00 - damage loss 15.00 = 25.00; remaining stock value 75.00.
reports.date_policy: See report-verification.md; source cutoff and business timezone are mandatory.

fixtures.INV: Isolated stock fixture: Bolt (ea), warehouses A/B; opening 100 at 10.00, receipt 20 at 10.00, issue 10, resalable return 2 at original 10.00, written-off damage 3, transfer 5 A→B. No reservation in baseline. Opening batch ends 89; receipt batch 20. Separate Zero product, low-stock threshold 150, and kg product prevent unit-mixing. Add held/reserved/expired variants before acceptance.
fixtures.SALE: Isolated sales fixture: customer A, one product costing 10.00/ea; credit invoice 10 at 20.00 (200.00), credit receipt 40.00, cash invoice 5 at 20.00 (100.00) with receipt 100.00, resalable credit return 2 at 20.00 (40.00) costing 20.00. No tax/discount in arithmetic baseline; add configured tax/discount variants. Event date 2026-01-31 in Asia/Karachi; out-of-range control sale at 2026-01-31T19:00:00Z is February locally.
fixtures.BUY: Isolated purchase fixture: order 100 ea; receipt 20 at 10.00; matched supplier invoice 200.00 (must not receive twice); return 2 at original 10.00 with debit note 20.00; payment 80.00. Remaining unreceived 80 ea, AP 100.00. No tax/charges in baseline; add snapshotted tax/landed-cost variants.
fixtures.ACC: Independent accounting fixture: opening inventory/equity 1000.00; purchase invoice/receipt 200.00; purchase return 20.00; supplier payment 80.00; credit sales 200.00; cash sales 100.00; customer credit return 40.00 (cost 20.00); sales COGS before return 150.00; credit receipt 40.00; cash-sale receipt 100.00; cash expense 20.00. Ending inventory 1050.00, cash 40.00, AR 120.00, AP 100.00, net revenue 260.00, COGS 130.00, expense 20.00, equity 1000.00. Due Jan 15, as-of Jan 31. February receipts/payments 50.00/30.00 must not change January aging.
fixtures.MFG: Isolated manufacturing fixture: consumed 20 kg at 5.00 (100.00), including 2 kg normal process waste; labor 20.00, overhead 30.00; output 10 accepted ea at 15.00. Sell 4 at 25.00 (revenue 100.00, cost 60.00), write off 1 finished ea (15.00), remaining 5 at 15.00 (75.00). WIP clears on completion; later sale/damage do not rewrite produced quantity or cost. Add partial output, quarantine/rejection and zero-yield variants.
